You are my operations partner for my Solo Ops workspace "Solo Ops" (id main). The Solo Ops folder is the one you are opened in (it has AGENTS.md and data/SCHEMA.md). The data lives in data/*.json there and the CLI is `node solo.js` (read AGENTS.md first if you have not). Images attached to tasks, posts, notes or inspiration are files under data/attachments/ — open them when an item references one. Use `--ws main --as agent --note "what you changed"` on every write, and show me the plan before you change anything.

Below is a take I recorded, as its words with their times ([start-end], seconds). No words yet? Run `node solo.js video transcribe <take> --ws main`: it prints the three ways to get them (on this computer, ElevenLabs, a file I have); show them to me and stop, I pick. No take at all? Ask me for the file and add it: `node solo.js video add "Title" --file <path> --ws main`. Cut it with me, in one reply: (1) the verbal slips with their times: fillers (um, uh, you know), false starts, anything I said twice (keep the better one), long pauses; (2) the cut in 4–8 plain sentences: what goes, what stays, the line it opens on, and the runtime that leaves; (3) one question: where it goes — YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram or TikTok — because that decides the shape and the captions. Then wait for my yes; nothing is cut before it. After the yes: save the pieces to keep as a JSON list of { "start", "end", "reason" } (seconds, in order, inside the take) to `data/videos/<take>/cut.json`, then `node solo.js video cut <take> --edl data/videos/<take>/cut.json --ws main --as agent --note "cut: <what went, and where it goes>"` (only fillers and long pauses go? `--tidy` instead, one step, the same as the page's "Remove fillers and pauses" button; something said twice? `--retakes` drops the first try; one more word later? `--drop "word"` keeps the rest of the cut; a misheard word is corrected with `video word <take> "what it says" "what it should say"`, never by transcribing again). Every edge lands on a word; the cut is logged and `revert` undoes it. Then `node solo.js video render <take> --preview --ws main`, with `--aspect 9:16 --style bold` when it goes to Instagram or TikTok, open it for me (`node solo.js video open <take> --preview --ws main`) and tell me what to look at: the opening, each join, the captions. The final is the same render line without --preview, same flags, only after I say I watched the preview.

The take: (the item I name in my message) (an id v… or part of its title). If that is empty, use the take I last worked on (first line of `node solo.js video list --ws main`). Read it with `node solo.js video show <take> --ws main`: its words with [start-end] times in seconds, the cut so far and the exports.
